title: 4권 8유닛 장면 · 2
prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. Bright cheerful palette (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky blue). Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image. Full illustrated scene: the background is made of a few large flat color shapes (ground, bushes, sky) with a calm plain sky area near the top, characters large and clearly visible. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Letter trees are ordinary round leafy trees with small fruits (like an orchard); never shape trees, clouds, paths or any object like letters of the alphabet. Use the attached character sheet ONLY to copy how the characters look. Draw ONLY these characters: Bun, Hedgie, Beads, Fairy E. Every other character on the sheet must NOT appear in this picture. Scene: At the bottom of the stone stair, by the dark moat water, Fairy E touches two little sparkles together with her star wand and they melt into one big bright sparkle that drops onto the water. As the friends read the word, a small red rowing boat with two oars rises up out of the water with a splash, shaking off snow. Beads hops in first; Bun and Hedgie cheer; the goat peeks from behind them. Hidden in the picture: the boat, the snow, the goat. Grumble does NOT appear. No letters anywhere. Characters: Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes. Beads is a small friendly caterpillar whose body is a string of five round beads in rainbow colors (red, orange, yellow, green, blue), big round sparkling eyes, two tiny antennae tipped with little beads, a cheerful open smile, no letters on the beads. Fairy E is a tiny palm-sized fairy glowing with soft golden light, a round rosy face with big sparkling eyes, short wavy lilac hair, a little dress made of pale-green leaf petals, two round see-through wings like soap bubbles, holding a thin wand tipped with a small yellow star, no letters or symbols drawn anywhere on her or her wand.
